## Summary

- Describe the change and why it is needed.
- Identify any new content rights, permissions or third-party attribution.

## Verification

- List checks actually run and their results.
- State unverified behavior or known limitations.

## Screenshots

Required for any visual change (layout, spacing, typography, color, responsive behavior): attach before and after screenshots to this description and state the viewport width when relevant, so reviewers can confirm the change is intended.

Attach from the terminal with gh 2.99+: run `gh pr edit <number> --attach ./before.png --attach ./after.png` (the images are appended to the description), or reference them in the body file as image links and pass `--body-file`. Dragging images into the description also works.

Never commit screenshots or other images to the repository as PR assets. For changes with no visual impact, write "No visual changes."
